laws.rule: Caazapá National Park: MADES publishes daily 07:00 to 17:00 public visiting hours, walking trails and a camping option. Camp only in designated areas and follow the control-post requirements held at country level.

sources.title: Caazapá National Park official visitor conditions and location
sources.supports: Read directly: named department, access conditions, visiting hours where published, and camping allowed or prohibited.

local-law.note: Named protected site only. National public-use rules apply from the country record. Other departmental and municipal levels not yet checked; no admission amount reproduced.
